snippet.title: Love and War: Act I Trailer
snippet.description:
A trailer for the RM2K RPG Love and War, Act I. Featuring the awesome artwork of King-sama, and lovingly scripted out by me, but ultimately put together by X-Calibar, a terrific guy! The music is "Toki wo Kizamu Uta", from the anime "Clannad". You can visit the Love and War website here: https://loveandwartherpg.com/ and can download Act I here: https://loveandwartherpg.com/downloads.html We hope you enjoy!

And please consider "Liking" us on Facebook, over yonder! https://www.facebook.com/loveandwartherpg
